fixed_on: 2026-10-22, before any regime result was computed
asked_by: 동동 2026-10-22: top-5 bundle in bear markets; compare with buy-and-hold
object: top5_distinct bundle of ADR 0024 (liquid_search_dev.py, same data, same search re-run; reproduction must give S1 2.16 / S2 2.46 or the difference is reported)
reads: S1 (2021-01-01..2023-09-18, 9 symbols) and S2 (2024-06-19..2025-10-20, ETH + 7 alts, no BTC) only; the tool's assert_allowed refuses everything else (validation, locked TEST, paper, IW1)
cost: assumed_public_v1 (unchanged); buy-and-hold pays entry cost once and funding every day it holds
market_index: equal-weight daily-rebalanced index of the segment's own symbols from the daily opens (BTC is not available in S2)

regimes.R1_trailing_90d: label for day d uses only index values up to d's open: index[d]/index[d-90] - 1 >= +20% -> BULL; <= -20% -> BEAR; else SIDEWAYS; days without 90 prior days -> UNLABELED
regimes.R2_drawdown: index[d] <= 0.75 * running peak of the index since the segment read_start -> DRAWDOWN (bear phase); else NOT_DRAWDOWN

benchmarks: S1: BTC hold, ETH hold, equal-weight basket hold
S2: ETH hold, equal-weight basket hold
metrics_per_segment_and_regime: max drawdown bp (cumulative arithmetic, same as ADR 0024)
monthly bp table for the R2 DRAWDOWN days
beta: OLS of bundle daily bp on EW basket hold daily bp (whole segment and BEAR/DRAWDOWN days only): beta, alpha bp/day, Newey-West(5) t of alpha
vol_matched: bundle scaled by sd(hold)/sd(bundle) (leverage) vs the hold: mean bp/day, cumulative bp, max drawdown; also hold scaled to the bundle's sd
exposure: average share of days the bundle is in a position and its average net long share (per rule, mean over symbols)
rules: no threshold or definition is changed after results; no statistical criterion is relaxed; if the bundle is weak in bear it is reported as weak
